finding: Bank willingness stable in Slovakia but macro outlook deteriorates further
bullets: A net 7.8% of Slovak firms (n=310) reported that banks' willingness to provide credit improved, unchanged from the previous wave and above the EA's net 5.6% and Germany's net -4.2% — suggesting stable financing conditions.

A net 51.6% of Slovak firms (n=472) reported a deteriorating general economic outlook, worsening by 7.2 pp from wave 38, and 22.2 pp more negative than the EA's net 29.4% — putting pressure on future investment plans.

Access to public financial support remained negative for Slovak firms (n=310) at a net -21.2%, though notably less so than wave 38's net -33.8%, compared with the EA's net -13.6% — limiting mitigation options for firms.
